name: Zoom
summary: Enable Waiting Room, require passcodes, and disable AI meeting transcription by default.

settings.name: Waiting Room
settings.impact: The Waiting Room is the single most effective barrier against uninvited guests (Zoombombing). It lets the host control who enters instead of allowing anyone with the link to join immediately.
settings.source: Reco.ai: 'Essential Guide to Zoom Security'; Valence Security Zoom Guide

settings.name: Meeting Passcodes
clickPath: Require a passcode when scheduling new meetings: Toggle ON
settings.impact: Meeting IDs can be guessed or found via social media. A passcode adds a second authentication layer, preventing random users from joining private meetings.
settings.source: Reco.ai Zoom Security Best Practices; Valence Security Guide

settings.name: AI Companion / Meeting Summary
settings.impact: AI Companion transcribes and summarizes meetings, creating a persistent record of conversations that may include confidential or privileged information.
settings.source: Georgetown University UIS Zoom AI Privacy Guide; Zoom Community documentation

settings.name: End-to-End Encryption
clickPath: Allow use of end-to-end encryption: Toggle ON
settings.impact: Zoom's default encryption is transport-level — Zoom can access content. E2EE encrypts so only meeting participants can see it. Trade-off: disables cloud recording and live transcription.
settings.source: Zoom Support: 'Enabling end-to-end encryption for Zoom meetings'; Mimecast Zoom Security Guide

settings.name: Automatic Cloud Recording
settings.impact: Cloud recordings are stored on Zoom's servers and can contain sensitive business or personal conversations. Disabling ensures meetings are not permanently stored without a deliberate decision.
settings.source: Emerson College Zoom Recording Security Guide; JHU Zoom Recording Best Practices
